items.question: Has Japanese Ramen Simulator been released?
items.answer: Yes. Wild Dog released the Windows Steam game in Early Access on October 9, 2026. The latest numerical patch verified here is v0.1.48.17626.

items.question: Can I play alone?
items.answer: Yes. The official Steam listing supports single-player and NPC part-time staff. The launch patch documents dish-clearing staff; it does not establish full kitchen automation.

items.question: How many players can join?
items.answer: Steam advertises up to six. Wild Dog’s October 9 press-release headline says up to ten, with six recommended, while its body repeats six. This wiki has not tested the larger limit.

items.question: Are there exact recipes for every bowl?
items.answer: The verified sources identify menu categories and Tantanmen broth options, but do not publish a complete quantity or scoring formula. Our cooking guides show confirmed rules and mark the missing details.

items.question: Is this an official game website?
items.answer: No. This is an independent fan reference. We link official announcements and distinguish confirmed mechanics from suggested kitchen workflows.

about.introduction: {siteName} is an independent English reference for {gameName}, a {genre} developed by {developer} for {platform}. We publish practical guides with source links and explicit Early Access version notes.

sections.title: What we cover
sections.body: Our launch edition covers cooking, shop routines, co-op, achievements, platform facts and the Day 1 patch.
items: Confirmed game mechanics appear with official source links.
Suggested workflows are editorial advice, not measured game formulas.
Unknown menu paths, quantities and unlocks remain unknown until verified.

sections.title: How we check information
sections.body: Official Steam announcements, store metadata and public achievements form the main evidence. Player discussions help identify problems; they do not establish a universal fix. Historical previews are not automatically treated as current mechanics.
items: Each article states the version and date reviewed.
We do not claim hands-on testing when a fact comes from a published source.
Research notes and article sources are available in our repository.

privacy.introduction: {siteName} is a static reference hosted on Cloudflare Pages. No account is required. This notice describes the features enabled for our launch edition.

sections.title: Hosting requests
sections.body: Cloudflare processes requests to deliver the site and operate its security and performance services. Request information can include an IP address and browser information. See Cloudflare’s own privacy policy for its handling of that information.

sections.title: Search and local preferences
sections.body: Pagefind search loads an index from this site and searches in your browser. Theme preferences and article helpfulness responses are stored locally in the browser; the current site has no server endpoint receiving those responses.
items: You can remove local preferences through your browser’s site-data controls.
No wiki account or sign-in is needed to read or search.

sections.title: Optional services
sections.body: Advertising, Google Analytics, Cloudflare Web Analytics and Giscus comments are not configured in the launch edition. Their template components remain available for a future explicit setup; enabling them requires reviewing this notice.

sections.title: External links
sections.body: Links to Steam, the developer and our GitHub issue tracker open those services, which apply their own policies. Avoid posting credentials or private account information in a public issue.

sections.title: Changes and questions
sections.body: A material change to enabled services will be reflected here. Use the wiki contact page to ask a site-related question or report a privacy concern.
